Metadata.title: Hydra Studios — Producer Collective in Malmö, Sweden
Metadata.description: Eight writers, producers and musicians under one roof in Malmö. Recording, mixing, mastering and production in rooms built by the people who use them.
Metadata.ogDescription: A producer collective in Malmö, Sweden — eight writers, producers and musicians under one roof.

Hero.subtitle: Hydra is eight writers, producers and musicians under one roof — rooms full of analog gear, and a kitchen where most of the songs actually start.

Studios.label: The Rooms
Studios.title: Our studios
Studios.subtitle: Five personal studios and the spaces between them — every room tuned by the head who works in it. No two sound the same. That's the point.

andreas.name: Andreas Studio
andreas.description: The big room. A Neve console at the centre, a proper live room, and a grand pianist's ear behind every decision made in it.

costa.name: Costa Studio
costa.description: Small room, big tempo. Warm acoustics, an SSL, and a steady supply of dance records in the making.

david.name: David Studio
david.description: An API console, modular synths and a guitar collection with real stage mileage. Analog warmth at modern speed.

dennis.name: Dennis Studio
dennis.description: The night shift. A pristine mixing and mastering suite where records go to find their last ten percent.

simon.name: Simon Studio
simon.description: The lab. Analog synths, boutique outboard and custom acoustics — built for sounds that don't exist yet.

common.name: Common Areas
common.description: The space between the doors. Kitchen, lounge and hallway — where ideas get traded and half the songwriting actually happens.

About.label: The House
About.paragraph1: Hydra started with a simple idea: put a group of producers who genuinely like each other under one roof, and let the rooms do the rest.
About.paragraph2: Every studio in the house is built and tuned by the person who works in it. No two rooms sound alike, and no project gets squeezed into a mould — you pick the room, and the head, that fits the music.
About.quote: We built the studio we always wanted to work in. Then we built five more.
About.paragraph3: But what really makes Hydra is the hallway between the doors. Songs travel here — a topline from one room, a mix from another, a saxophone from down the hall. You book a studio; you get a collective.

Services.label: What We Do
Services.subtitle: Everything a record needs under one roof — and a head who treats each stage like it's the whole job.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: Acoustically treated rooms, a deep microphone locker and analog signal chains that flatter whatever you put in front of them. Come in with a song; leave with a record.
features: Multiple live rooms and isolation booths

mixing.title: Mixing
mixing.description: Hybrid mixing in precision-tuned rooms — analog heart, digital recall. We take a mix to the point where you can't stop playing it back.

production.title: Production
production.description: Full production from first hum to final session — arrangement, musicians, instruments and a creative direction that protects the song.

mastering.title: Mastering
mastering.description: The last set of ears. Dedicated suites, reference monitoring and format-specific masters that survive every speaker they meet.

collaboration.title: Artist Collaboration
collaboration.description: Hydra is more than rooms for rent — it's a working collective. Plug into our network of writers, players and producers, or just stay for lunch.

residency.title: Studio Residency
residency.description: A creative home base. Long-term access, your gear exactly where you left it, and seven neighbours who happen to make records too.

Team.label: The Heads
Team.subtitle: Producers, writers and multi-instrumentalists — each with their own room, their own animal, and strong opinions about inbox management.

andreas.name: Andreas "Stone" Johansson
andreas.description: Grand piano, long-renowned songwriter and producer. Fantastic pianist and meticulously fussy. In every sense of the word.
andreas.likes: Editing, to the point where he never stops.

david.name: David Fremberg
david.description: With years of artist and live experience, he accounts for the most amps and live elements in his recordings.
david.likes: KISS more than anything, and his rediscovered love for trad jazz.
david.hates: Throwing away emails in the inbox.

denniz.name: Denniz Jamm
denniz.description: Calm, methodical, night owl. Always works the night shift. Denniz loves to mix and has a special ear for taking the mix to new heights.
denniz.likes: Sleeping in, nightclubs, and mixing dance music.
denniz.hates: Cold weather — happily flees when there's no warmth left in Malmö.

costa.name: Costa Leon
costa.description: Hydra's own DJ, with years of experience as a producer and songwriter, but also has an artist career alongside his creative work. Costa keeps a high tempo but still takes it easy. He's Greek, after all.
costa.hates: Early mornings. But he always seems to still be around come morning.

simon.name: Simon Peyron
simon.description: Also known as "celebrity Simon", with the epithets "baker on kids' TV" and metal singer, Simon is a bright spark at Hydra. With extensive experience in production, mixing, and songwriting, Simon is a nerd to his fingertips.
simon.hates: That this website never gets finished, but SOON!

peter.name: Peter Zimny
peter.description: Official brass master. If it has a hole, he'll blow into it — and make it sound good too. One of Sweden's most sought-after multi-instrumentalists. Saxophone, flute, clarinet — you name it.
peter.likes: Water fasting, tennis, and talking about water fasting and tennis.

johan.name: Johan Lundén
johan.description: He hasn't been assigned an animal yet — a ceremony is planned for later this year. Johan has extensive experience in songwriting and audio post-production for film and gaming. We're very happy to have him on board.
johan.hates: Not really sure, he always seems so happy.

thomas.name: Thomas "Tomme" Wallén
thomas.description: The house dad, the reassuring teacher on a chaotic playground. Thomas is the oil in the machine — making sure songs reach artists and that artists actually show up now and then. Without him, no Hydra.
thomas.likes: Royalty reporting and making Excel files.
thomas.hates: Royalty reporting and making Excel files — so now he has a system for it.

Music.subtitle: A rolling playlist of work that's been written, produced or mixed in the house.
